entities.summary: Kuusamo is a town and municipality in Finland. It is located in Koillismaa, the northeastern part of the Northern Ostrobothnia region. The municipality has a population of 14,792 and covers an area of 5,808.92 square kilometres (2,242.84 sq mi) of which 830.81 km2 (320.78 sq mi) is water. The population density is 2.97 inhabitants per square kilometre (7.7/sq mi). Kuusamo is a town in Northern Europe, established around 1868. Holds notable historical significance, documented across 61 language editions of Wikipedia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
